name: docker-playwright-lab
description: Hands-on Docker lab using Playwright to explore reproducible development environments, Docker Compose, image publishing, and CI workflows
author: https://github.com/aldimhernandez

scripts.docker:setup: docker compose pull && docker compose run --rm dev npm ci
scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm dev npm test
scripts.docker:ui: docker compose run --rm --service-ports dev npm run test:ui:docker
scripts.test:ui:docker: npx bddgen && echo "Open Playwright UI at http://localhost:9323" && npx playwright test --ui --ui-host=0.0.0.0 --ui-port=9323
